title: Mistral is rumored to be raising €3B at €20B valuation
brief: Mistral is reportedly raising €3 billion ($3.5 billion) in new funding at a €20 billion ($23.15 billion) valuation, nearly doubling its Series C valuation of €11.7 billion. This round reflects strong investor confidence in the French AI company as it scales its LLM capabilities and competes with larger AI players.
